assessment_objectives.objective: roles and responsibilities exist to compel data and/or process owners to monitor the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) under their control on an ongoing basis for applicable threats and risks, and to confirm that security, compliance and resilience controls are operating as intended.

Individual Contributor (IC) performance reviews cover how data and/or process owners monitor the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) under their control on an ongoing basis for applicable threats and risks, and confirm that security, compliance and resilience controls are operating as intended.
